evidence_as_of.scope: Tracked literal registered-version references include src, apps, scripts, tests, and docs as of source_commit. Artifact evidence retains the 2026-08-20 read-only inspection of data, generated, local_data, and a representative tmp sample. Semantic producer/reader evidence remains separately reviewed.

generic_consumers.mechanism: Resolves schema versions supplied by discovered manifests through get_table_spec(schema_version).
generic_consumers.scope: Any registered schema version referenced by a dashboard-discovered manifest.
generic_consumers.removal_effect: A zero literal-reference count cannot establish zero production readers; each removal packet must review manifest compatibility and generic consumers.

status_definitions.active_core: A current producer, reader, or operational persistence contract depends on this schema.
status_definitions.active_experiment: A research, paper, canary, or deferred subsystem owns this schema; absence from routine operation is not removal evidence.
status_definitions.compatibility_legacy: Retained only to interpret or migrate an older contract; removal requires retained-data and external-consumer evidence.
status_definitions.provisional_unintegrated: Registered but without a demonstrated end-to-end producer and reader.
status_definitions.removal_candidate: Evidence currently favors retirement, but removal is forbidden until the catalog's stop conditions are cleared.

groups.summary: Capture, venue ingestion, matching, tracking, and their persisted provenance contracts.
Offline analysis and research sidecars; keep until each experiment is separately retired.
Execution, paper, canary, and soak contracts are deliberately frozen in this phase rather than assessed for removal.
Legacy match contract whose retained-data claim and reader behavior require characterization.
Proposed canonical dimensions with builders and tests but no demonstrated production producer or reader.
Trimmed snapshot export contracts without a current writer or observed retained artifact.

removal_stop_conditions: Any production or script producer/reader reference remains.
Any retained artifact, manifest, journal, bundle, or downstream hash pin references the schema.
Any declared artifact root is missing, unreadable, malformed, or incompletely scanned.
External notebook or manual-script compatibility has not been decided by the maintainer.
Migration would change grain, primary-key semantics, schema meaning, or discard fields.
Removal would require moving, rewriting, or re-hashing retained data.
Focused or repository-wide verification is not green.
